title: Disasters
content: Ive encountered tsunamis and tornados in MW, but has anyone had an a non-weather related disaster in their dream? Twice now Ive dreamt off an attack in the city. Unknown planes start appearing overhead at first. Sometimes they look like fighter jets, other times like something that vaguely resembles a plane (ufo?) I can usually see them in the distance at first, flying in over the water and then above the skyline of the city. They begin to drop bombs that blow out huge pieces of the hotel/office buildings. At this point Im usually running through the streets, trying to find my family/friends so we can get out. The bombing becomes so intense, that the streets start to splinter open, and fire/lave begins to bubble up. These splinters eventually move out to the forest and mountain range, until it looks like the entire city has cracked open. Both times I have found my car and started hauling ass down the street, turning down side roads, avoiding lava filled ravines, and racing out of town (to where, I dont know), but along the way I can see houses burning, and I feel the overwhelming sense of dread that people have died, and there is no answer to why any of this is happening. It feels very real, to the point that that I can feel the heat from the fire, and when I wake up, that feeling of dread is still hovering over me.
